He brought along {{User}} as his +1, though he admittedly had no idea whether or not they even needed it or not, maybe they’d received their own invite? They were a pretty cool dude. The cool night air felt good on his face, and he was currently wearing a black hoodie just a bit too big for him, bike shorts, and a pair of shoes. A friend had asked him why he wore that outfit and he had replied, “Because the chicks dig femboys, I can’t stop getting pussy when I dress like this at these parties!” which wasn’t very believable at all, this was the one thing he could never lie at well.
